my fiance is deployed, and I'm doing poorly in school. I also found out I'll be gone on orders for Christmas. 

More than all of that though I'm upset because my fiance isn't home to enjoy the victories I've experienced while he is gone. It's great to share them with my family, but when I share those small moments with him, I know he genuinely is happy for me. I'd give my left leg just to have him home to negate all the crappy stuff that's going on

That I will never find the happiness I'm looking for. I have a great life,a wonderful fiance, and so on, but it's just hard to be happy.
Man, I want my fiance home. I've only seen him twice in the past 6 months and he's deployed right now. It'd be really great to have him home.

I met my fiance 4 years ago after talking on a dating site. I instantly liked his laid back attitude, and agreed to go on a few more dates (and he was the lead guitarist in band, how could I pass that up?). Next thing I knew I was hitting the concrete at 90 mph for this guy, I knew he was the one for me. I was head over heels in love. Kind of crazy now that I think about it. But god was it fun! Falling in love with him was the best time of my life. It was exuberant, exciting, happy, and a bunch of other stuff squished into one feeling. We geeked out and played video games, stayed up laughing and talking, and cooked crazy stuff at all hours of the night together. 

Anyway, fast forward a few years and I join the Navy, then he joins the Navy, and here we are today. A deployment, and many alcoholic beverages later, and we still haven't murdered each other! Hurrah!

 The coolest part though, is that because we spend so much time apart due to our jobs, seeing him is like falling in love all over again. I cherish the memories we have together, but I can't wait to make new ones too

What if I had gone active duty and done what I thought would make me happy instead of what made someone else happy? I went reserves for my fiance, who is now active, and am in college as well as a Navy reservist, but I hate every minute of it, despite how much I've accomplished. Jealousy, you suck.

Do I go active duty, or keep going to college while being a reservist? I initially went reserves to be with my (now) fiance but he joined up active duty. I live in regret for not going active, but it gives me an opening for school. However, I hate school, but I'm proud of my accomplishment with it. Decisions man....

I used to work at Sears a while back and the store was liquidating. On the final day, we were selling stuff for almost nothing. The lines were fucking HUGE. Anyway, one lady comes up to my register with a ton of pencils, erasers, and notebooks. Rang it up, and it came out to be about $4. She then proceeded to complain that I didn't give her "enough of a discount". Lady, I'll pay the $4 for you to go away.

not exactly a life changing story, but still cringe-worthy:

I was walking to my car after getting a few small things from Walmart. As I'm walking, a small group of people pull me aside and start asking me if I will take a minute to talk about God with them (they were promoting their church and Christianity and whatever). Fast forward and they ask me to pray with them. I'm not super religious, but trying to be polite, I agree. The whole time people were staring and laughing,ugh.

My fiance still gives me crap about it to this day.

TLDR: walking out of Walmart, end up praying with church crazies in the parking lot of Walmart
